answer: A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The zenith multiplier is published, charged in canyon, and oasis lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 3 for every identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 3553 identities would post 2318 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
